If you only do one thing before your first R session

Confirm you can sign in to the CSUB JupyterHub (see Option B below). It
requires no installation and is what CSUB labs use, so it is the
lowest-risk way to make sure you can do R work on day one — even if a
laptop installation runs into trouble.
Option A — Install R and RStudio on your own computer

Option B — The CSUB JupyterHub (nothing to install)

children.label: Option B — The CSUB JupyterHub (nothing to install)

Step 2 — Sign in with your CSUB credentials.
